586-1472-4247-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-4247-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

1657-7388.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Rocksteady trigger.
Resolve the Rocksteady trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4770-5789-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5789-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1496-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2438-5058-7422.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1069-3169-4659-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-3169-4659-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

586-1368-1745-5708.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
586-1368-1745-5708.description:
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat.

24-220-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Brash Taunter instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-220-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-2292-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

500-1777-2239.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ardent Elementalist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Ardent Elementalist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Ardent Elementalist token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2225-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4131-4452.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4131-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-4131-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

165-1069-3480-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-3480-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

767-3008-3048-5641.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Basking Broodscale has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Druids' Repository has at least one charge counter on it.
767-3008-3048-5641.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale and two charge counters on Druids' Repository.
Basking Broodscale triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Druids' Repository twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Alternatively, you may only remove one counter from Druids' Repository and sacrifice an Eldrazi Spawn instead.

2363-4396-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Hangarback Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4068-4803-5144-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4803-5144-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Ephemerate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1676-2034-3374.notablePrerequisites: Boss's Chauffeur does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1676-2034-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Boss's Chauffeur persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur, adding {C}{C}.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its second ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur to the battlefield from your graveyard with at least one +1/+1 counter due to its ability.
Resolve the second Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur when it died.
Repeat.

1218-3946-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
1218-3946-5064.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

1420-2178-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-5256.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

1143-1912-4277.notablePrerequisites: Diviner's Wand attached to any creature you control.
1143-1912-4277.description:
Activate the creature with Diviner's Wand attached by paying {2}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat.
